entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • GetRelationalModel throws "The model must be finalized" when two threads make the first call at once (check-then-act on RelationalModelFactory) #39214
    12.0.0
  • Split query + projection with Skip/Take: paging subquery still has no key ordering in EF 10, child collections come back empty #39206

Closed

  • Can't include constant GUIDs in the projection #35826
    12.0-preview1
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #39192
    8.0.x
  • Code for precompiled query with .AsNoTracking() has variable name with dots in it #37972
    12.0-preview1
  • [M.D.Sqlite] improve support for GetSchema() #35917
    12.0-preview1
  • Improve visibility of MySQL provider compatibility for new EF Core releases #39167

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix GetRelationalModel throwing when the relational model is created concurrently #39216
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Fix Cosmos concurrency tests by normalizing ETag comparisons #39215
    area-test
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage from 18.11.2 to 18.12.0 #39213
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26473.115 to 11.0.0-beta.26509.3 #39212
    area-infrastructure
  • Differentiate overloaded functions and stored procedures in TableMappingBaseComparer #39211
    community-contribution
  • Improve error message when provider does not support reverse engineering #39209
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39205

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39207
  • Fix constant guid select #39200
    community-contribution
  • Use ShortName for precompiled query liftable constant variables #39208
    community-contribution
  • Implement SQLite ADO.NET schema collections #39188
    community-contribution
  • Bump actions/upload-code-coverage from 1.4.3 to 1.4.4 #39210
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0] Preserve value-converter cast when simplifying projections #39195
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0] Report CommandSource.ExecuteDelete for ExecuteDelete commands #39199
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/10.0] Report CommandSource.ExecuteDelete for ExecuteDelete commands #39197
    Servicing-approved
